skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find an LCD or convenient common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract and simplify fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities with a common denominator by operating on numerators and express the fractional result in simplest form, including zero or whole-number results when appropriate.

skills.name: Manage mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Separate whole-number and fractional parts, account for missing whole or fractional parts as zero, subtract whole parts, and recombine the final result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the fractional-part subtraction would be negative.
